parameters.name: ClusterType
parameters.description: The type of the cluster. For cloud services, set this parameter to `cloud-product-prometheus`.

parameters.name: Length
parameters.description: The length of the cluster ID. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: Product
parameters.description: The name of the cloud service. This parameter must be specified when ClusterType is set to `cloud-product-prometheus`. Valid values: influxdb, mongodb, and DLA. You cannot specify multiple service names.

parameters.name: RecreateSwitch
parameters.description: Specifies whether to create or query a virtual cluster. This parameter provides backward compatibility.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms open-vcluster --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-type cloud-product-prometheus --length 10 --product influxdb --recreate-switch false --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun arms OpenVCluster --region cn-hangzhou --Length 10 --Product influxdb --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClusterType 'cloud-product-prometheus' --RecreateSwitch false
